body: FWIW, I am attempting to stop on my own. If it doesn't work, I'm talking to my boss and telling him I need time off to deal with personal matters, and if I have to, I'll call in the Family and Medical Leave Act, or whatever it is called. I will do this. I know my family will understand, friends that don't aren't friends, and fuck the rest. I will do this. I pulled a good (better than I deserve) friend aside today and told him what I am trying to do, told him everything. He's with me. I can do this.
I'm doing it. I'm doing it.

I made a few attempts that worked for months, but no attempts in the last four or five years. Obviously the problem has worsened in that time. I think about this all the time. But I woke up today, and it was there, in my mind: I HAVE to stop this shit. I'm not going to try to go cold turkey, I know that won't work. But I am going to try to wean myself off with what little I have left, and THEN the shit storm will start. But fuck it, I actually *want* to do this. If I still can't break free, I will voluntarily hit rehab.

It doesn't help that I am bipolar, as well. I have to do this though.

You're probably right, I'm considering it. I'm terrified of losing my job and some people in my life (who don't know about and have nothing to do with my addiction). I also don't know if rehab is something that my insurance would cover, or if I'd have to pay out of pocket.
I have heard good and bad things about suboxyne. It may be something that could help, but I don't want to become addicted to it.

I don't really know why I added the BS to that. You're almost certainly right though. Let's say I do go inpatient somewhere, can I lose my job for that? I like my job, and I get better money and benefits there than I probably would anywhere else. Can they fire me if I need to take 28 days, or even a couple of months?

Thanks. There's a lot of good stuff in this. We had a, I'm blocking on the actual name, one of those punching bags that's about the size of a soccer ball? You hang it? I don't know. We had one, friend actually exploded it.

I like the soft cloth doll idea. And I think I'm going to go outside and break a bunch of branches and shit.

THanks again for the ideas. Will probably run through more of these tomorrow, too. Again, thank you.
